evidence.title: Wedge - YC company profile
evidence.excerpt: 👋 Hey everyone, this is Dev and Steven. We’re the co-founders of Wedge 👋 TLDR: Wedge helps hesitant hospitals, health plans, and multi-physician organizations finally start using AI. We are the first platform to forward-deploy engineers inside health institutions to build custom agentic AI solutions. Our ask: We’d love to get introduced with director or c-suite folks at hospitals, especially if they’re currently implementing AI or want to implement AI. Contact us: founders@wedge.health Problem: There’s two types of AI being implemented in healthcare: Here’s why they don’t work (and as a result, why you’re not seeing AI in the doctor’s office): Solution: That’s where Wedge comes in: we forward-deploy top engineering talent at each health organization we work with to custom build out the perfect solution for them. Once we’re done, AI products in that health institution are monitored and maintained by us forever. Traction: When the need is great, traction is easy. It normally takes months and years to get contracts with health institutions. We’re piloting at 60+ locations after just one week. Interested in our GTM strategy? Let’s talk. Team: Devraj Gopal (CEO): Ex-Stanford AI. Worked on health AI at Stanford & Hopkins Med. Steven Segawa (CTO): Ex-Berkeley CS + Lead ML Data Scientist at NVIDIA. Ex-Rivian, SoFi, Intel.

It flags discrepancies to prevent revenue leakage and ensures accurate financial reconciliation. - AI RECORDS RETRIEVAL The AI Records Retrieval agent automates the intake and fulfillment of medical record requests. It securely retrieves records from EHRs, generates audit trails, and reduces staff time spent on manual chart pulls. - AI GOVERNANCE The AI Governance agent provides continuous oversight of all deployed AI tools in a health system. It enforces compliance, monitors performance, and ensures safe, auditable AI operations. - AI RECEPTIONIST The AI Receptionist manages patient calls, scheduling, and front-desk inquiries. It identifies and resolves denials, resubmits claims, and maximizes revenue recovery. - AI MEDICAL CODER The AI Medical Coder automatically translates clinical notes into ICD-10, CPT, and HCPCS codes. It improves coding accuracy, speeds up claims submission, and reduces denials.
